It seeds nothing: X07 reaches its ten sites by the Settings debug teleport and pins clock and weather, both permitted here and ONLY here because the segment is prefixed DIAG (§0.1). The price of that permission is §0.6's other half -- no pacing, navigation, difficulty or economy claim may ever be sourced from these frames. They are a look at the world, not at the journey.
